CURRENT QUESTION:
share of money raised from repeat givers versus one-time givers, in percent, plus a count of repeat givers
attempts.response:
```sql
WITH donor_counts AS (
    SELECT
        "Donor",
        COUNT(*) AS donation_count
    FROM donations
    GROUP BY "Donor"
),
donor_type AS (
    SELECT
        d."Donor",
        d."Amount",
        CASE WHEN dc.donation_count > 1 THEN 'Repeat' ELSE 'One-time' END AS giver_type
    FROM donations d
    JOIN donor_counts dc ON d."Donor" = dc."Donor"
),
totals AS (
    SELECT
        giver_type,
        SUM("Amount") AS total_amount
    FROM donor_type
    GROUP BY giver_type
),
overall AS (
    SELECT SUM("Amount") AS grand_total FROM donor_type
),
percentages AS (
    SELECT
        t.giver_type,
        t.total_amount,
        (t.total_amount / NULLIF(o.grand_total, 0)) * 100 AS percent_amount
    FROM totals t
    CROSS JOIN overall o
),
repeat_count AS (
    SELECT COUNT(*) AS repeat_givers
    FROM donor_counts
    WHERE donation_count > 1
)
SELECT
    ROUND(p.percent_amount, 2) AS percent_repeat,
    ROUND(100 - p.percent_amount, 2) AS percent_one_time,
    rc.repeat_givers
FROM percentages p
JOIN repeat_count rc
WHERE p.giver_type = 'Repeat';
```
